name: May 2023
provenance: NOAA MRMS historical precipitation estimate; reprojected and aggregated to 2 km.
description: Selected historical interval, not synthetic rainfall and not a validated MHFD catalog event.

selection.method: Maximum AORC domain-mean accumulated depth within the documented acquisition period; earliest on ties. Identical UTC windows used for MRMS.
selection.catalog_scope: Three selected periods, not a complete annual or top-10 historical catalog.

source_metadata.name: May 2023
source_metadata.processing: NOAA hourly depths area-averaged with GDAL to 2 km UTM cells; no temporal interpolation; rounded to 0.0001 mm/h. Not unaltered NOAA data.

source_metadata.independent_validation: Not gauge-validated. Source quality and projection affect estimates.

georeference.name: MHFD district boundary — interim study-area proxy
georeference.coordinate_mapping: Easting_m = origin_easting_m + x_km * 1000; Northing_m = origin_northing_m + y_km * 1000. Grid axes are cell centers.
georeference.placement: Georeferenced NOAA precipitation, area-averaged to 2 km UTM grid.
georeference.study_boundary_status: Published MHFD district boundary is an interim proxy; project-specific study boundary pending.
georeference.metrics_domain: Full 100 x 100 km projected grid; no district-boundary clipping or masking. Areas are planar UTM grid areas.
georeference.bearing_reference: UTM grid north, not geodetic true north.

methodology.depth_area_note: Exploratory concentration curve: cumulative cell depths ranked descending, then averaged over increasing area. Not a validated engineering ARF; selected cells need not be contiguous.
methodology.tracking_note: Intensity-weighted centroids of cells ≥0.1 mm/h. Drift speed uses consecutive active intervals only; dry gaps are not bridged. Bearing uses first-to-last active centroid. Growth, decay, multiple cells and boundary clipping affect centroid drift; it is not physical storm velocity.
methodology.integration_note: Rates are interval averages in mm/h; each interval contributes rate × timestep, including the last. Domain means include dry cells. x increases east and y increases north; axes are cell centers in local km.
methodology.edge_note: The ≥1 mm/h storm footprint touches the domain boundary; area and motion may be truncated.
methodology.classification_note: No storm type assigned. Morphology and validated event classification remain future work.
methodology.sampling_note: One-hour accumulation intervals from the source. Values are hourly mean intensities, not instantaneous peaks. No temporal interpolation.
methodology.geographic_note: Area-averaged onto a 50 x 50 grid with 2 km cells in EPSG:32613. Statistics cover the entire 100 x 100 km square, not the MHFD polygon.
methodology.source_note: Historical gridded estimates derived from observations/analyses, not direct measurements at every cell. Source and spatial aggregation influence peaks.
methodology.selection_note: Maximum AORC domain-mean accumulated depth within the documented acquisition period; earliest on ties. Identical UTC windows used for MRMS.

quality.source_notice: MRMS multisensor hourly precipitation estimate; product quality is not independently validated.

movement_path.note: Experimental hourly pattern motion, not a measured centroid or validated storm-cell track. Square-root-weighted centers anchor disconnected segments. Null positions mark ambiguity, coverage loss or drift resets. Agreement is a heuristic, not a probability. Rainfall and raw centroid metrics are unchanged.
